payload.description_html: Holotype left maxilla of Sonselasuchus cedrus. (PEFO 47305/UWBM 119436). Left maxilla in A, lateral, B, medial, C, dorsal, and D, ventral views. Anatomical abbreviations: als, alveolar surface; aof, antorbital fenestra; a.n, articulation with nasal; ap, anterior process; dp, dorsal process; en, external naris; k, kink; lr, labial ridge; mf, maxillary fossa; os, occlusal surface; pp, posterior process; snf, subnarial foramen; vf, ventral fossa of anterior process. Scale bar equals 1 cm.
